page: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Standard4.Ax.Flex.2-8 is an x86_64 compute instance powered by an Intel Xeon 6987C-P processor operating at a clock speed of 3.9 GHz. The virtual machine allocates 4 vCPUs backed by 2 dedicated physical cores, providing 2 threads per core. System memory totals 8.0 GB, establishing a 2.0 GB per-core allocation and a 1:2 vCPU-to-memory ratio.

The instance configuration omits integrated local storage, requiring external block or object storage volumes for persistent data retention. It includes no discrete hardware accelerators, with a GPU count of zero. Network connectivity features one complimentary public IPv4 address.

With its dedicated high-frequency cores and compact memory footprint, this instance profile offers cost efficiency for compute-oriented tasks that do not demand extensive RAM capacity. The configuration is appropriate for web serving, continuous integration and deployment pipelines, batch compute tasks, and distributed microservices.
